plugins.name: github-cli-health-check
plugins.description: Dual-path daily GitHub CLI health check. Runs as both a Claude Code cloud Routine (native gh access) and a Cowork scheduled task via Desktop Commander (Mac host gh) — redundant on purpose so either path catches a failure in the other. Works around Cowork sandbox api.github.com block (claude-code#37970).

skills.name: github-cli-health-check
skills.description: Run a GitHub CLI (gh) health check — verify installation, authentication, list repos, and check API rate limit. Runtime-aware: on the cloud Routine path it uses native `gh`; in Cowork it routes through Desktop Commander to the host Mac's `gh`; locally it uses whichever `gh` is on PATH. Use this skill when the user says "GitHub health check", "check gh CLI", "is GitHub working", "gh auth check", "check my GitHub", "GitHub CLI health check", "test gh", "verify GitHub access", or any request to verify that the GitHub CLI is authenticated and operational. Also triggered by a scheduled task named "github-cli-health-check".
headings: Two live paths — pick at runtime
Execution path A — Routine / cloud (primary, when applicable)
Execution path B — Cowork scheduled task (fallback via Desktop Commander)
Execution path C — Interactive local session
Report template (identical across all paths, only the header tag changes)
GitHub CLI Health Check — YYYY-MM-DD (Cowork / DC)
